elements.label: Figure 1.13
elements.description:
Two-panel bar chart. Y-axis on both panels: "Share of panel households (%)", scale 0–80 in steps of 10. Bars are teal. Notes: share of panel households experiencing an increase in real consumption per capita. Source: WB calculations using VHLSS panel.

Left panel, "Two-year periods" (categories 2010–2012, 2012–2014, 2014–2016, 2016–2018; no values printed): ~61, ~57, ~70, ~60.

Right panel, "Four-year periods" (categories 2010–2014, 2012–2016, 2014–2018; no values printed): ~63, ~71, ~73.

The pattern: the share is roughly 57–70% in two-year periods, peaking in 2014–2016, and is higher in each four-year period (about 63–73%) than in the two-year periods, rising across the four-year windows.
